per_file.verdict: Well-structured client component with proper a11y patterns (aria-pressed, aria-label, aria-expanded), good empty state, useMemo filtering. Filtering logic is clean. Touch targets slightly below 44px threshold on chips. No loading skeleton for master list.

issues.message: Filter chips use py-2.5 = ~34px total height, below 44px mobile minimum. Bump to py-3.
Category chips same pattern as filter chips — ~34px total height, below 44px minimum.
MasterCard active:scale-[0.95] on bento-card inside <Link> — animation can cause layout shift during navigation.
No loading skeleton for masters list. If masters prop arrives empty-then-filled, users see abrupt content flash.
getCategoryIcon called per-render for every card and chip — should be extracted to a constant map or memoized.
City dropdown options animate out with framer-motion but keyboard navigation through listbox isn't fully ARIA-compliant (no active-descendant).

per_file.verdict: Severe monolith (1127 lines) combining availability, flash deals, schedule grid, shop banner, portfolio gallery, services, products, reviews, loyalty, C2C, booking flow, social sharing. Hardcoded Blossom-specific colors (#6B5750, #A8928D, #F5E8E3, rgba(255,210,194,0.55)) break Studio/Frost themes. Extensive isDark branching instead of CSS variable theming. Dependency array suppression. Full-page side-effect on document.body.backgroundColor.

issues.message: 1127-line component. Contains: Availability (hook), FlashDeals strip, schedule grid, shop banner, portfolio, services, products preview, reviews, trusted partners, loyalty, C2C banners, share button, booking flow + skeleton. Must be extracted into page-level composition (server + 5-6 leaf components).
Hardcoded textSecondary = '#6B5750', textTertiary = '#A8928D' — Blossom-specific, breaks on Studio dark theme (text becomes invisible on dark bg) and Frost theme.
Hardcoded avatarBg = 'rgba(255, 210, 194, 0.55)' — Blossom pink, invisible on Studio dark teal background.
Hardcoded socialBtnBg = '#F5E8E3' — Blossom-specific taupe, no contrast on Studio dark surfaces.

Schedule day bg: isWorking ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' — white overlay on already-light Blossom surface creates no visual distinction. On Studio dark theme, white overlay contradicts the dark design language.
text-[var(--accent-on)] — should use Tailwind token text-primary-foreground which already maps to --accent-on.
eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppresses dependency warnings for C2C balance fetch. Indicates missing deps in the dependency array.
useEffect sets document.body.style.backgroundColor — imperatively mutating DOM outside React tree. Can conflict with theme switching.
BookingFlowSkeleton has no role='status' or aria-label for screen readers — loading state is invisible to assistive tech.
Double-render strategy (hydrated state) causes content flash on every visit. Intentional for SSR date mismatch prevention but jarring UX.
Non-null assertion master.schedule! — if schedule changes causes a re-render where schedule is null, this crashes.

per_file.verdict: Solid commerce experience with cart logic, stepper controls, delivery picker, and empty/success states. Type quality suffers (any types for workingHours/schedule). Hardcoded category colors and black gradient overlays break theming. Inline price formatting duplicated across components.

issues.message: CATEGORY_COLORS: hardcoded hex colors (#A87C5C, #C2739A, #5FA89A, etc.) not theme-aware. On Studio/Frost themes, these clash with the palette.
workingHours?: any — should be typed. Using any defeats TypeScript benefits.
schedule?: any[] — same issue. Any-typed array.
from-black/25 gradient overlay on product images — hardcoded black, not theme-aware. On dark themes, black-on-dark lacks contrast.
style={{ background: 'var(--text-tertiary)' }} — --text-tertiary is not registered as a Tailwind alias. Should use text-muted-foreground (which maps to --text-tertiary).
Sticky cart button uses pb-28 (112px) — hardcoded to match --bottom-nav-height: 76px + padding. Doesn't account for safe-area-inset-bottom on notched phones.
FilterChip uses py-1.5 = ~32px total, below 44px mobile minimum.
ProductTile has no min-height guarantee on touch targets for small screens.
Price formatting (val / 100).toFixed(0) repeated at least 6 times in file — extract to a formatPrice helper (already used in PublicMasterPage).

per_file.verdict: Small focused component with proper empty handling and horizontal scroll snap. Hardcoded reference color #789A99 in 'see all' dashed border breaks theming. Surface reference uses CSS variable but Tailwind alias available.

issues.message: dashed border color 'rgba(120,154,153,0.4)' uses hardcoded #789A99 — this sage green is Blossom-specific. On Studio/Frost this color doesn't exist in the palette.
style={{ background: 'var(--surface)' }} — should use bg-secondary Tailwind alias. Same for border: should be border-border.
photo_count badge bg-black/40 — hardcoded black, not theme-aware. On Frost theme, black overlay on indigo-tinted images looks muddy.
Cover image container size-44 assumes square crops — will distort non-square portfolio images.
initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 16 }} — subtle entrance animation, but items slide in from right which can feel disconnected in a horizontal scroll context.

per_file.verdict: Strong server component pattern with parallel data fetching, proper metadata, and notFound. Handles all consent statuses (approved/pending). But hardcoded Blossom-only colors (#FFE8DC, #FFD4BE, #2C1A14) make this page broken on Studio/Frost themes. Type-unsafe profile cast.

issues.message: Hardcoded background '#FFE8DC' — Blossom-only peach. On Studio theme, this is extremely light against dark teal header. On Frost, the warm peach clashes with lavender palette.
Hardcoded gradient '#FFD4BE' — Blossom-specific pink-peach. Full background replacement needed per theme.
Hardcoded CTA background '#2C1A14' — dark brown. On Studio theme, should be --accent (gold); on Frost, should be --accent (near-black). Text 'text-white' also hardcoded.
as unknown as { full_name: string; avatar_url: string | null } — double cast bypasses type checking. If Supabase schema changes, this silently breaks.
bookings count uses new Date() for month start — server timezone, not client. Could show wrong count for edge-of-month times.
Back header uses color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 92%, transparent) — creative use but fragile. Should be a well-defined token.
revalidate=300 suitable for ISR, but portfolio item descriptions could change without immediate propagation.

per_file.verdict: Clean accordion-style studio member listing with proper empty state for services. CSS grid-template-rows animation has limited browser support (Safari). Minor dupes with formatPrice/formatDuration but overall well-scoped.

issues.message: grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr transition is not supported in Safari (webkit bug). The accordion collapse is instant on Safari instead of animated.
formatPrice function duplicates PublicMasterPage line 135-137. Extract to shared utility.
formatDuration function duplicates similar formatting logic elsewhere. Extract to shared utility.
Link with active:scale-[0.95] — visual feedback works but animation is defined on anchor, which may cause layout thrash on navigation.
Studio badge backdrop-blur is decorative only — fine, but no visible label for screen readers distinguishing studio type.

per_file.verdict: Tight server component with proper token hashing and expiry check. Missing error boundary — unhandled Supabase query exception propagates to 500 page. No loading state.

issues.message: No try/catch around supabase query. Network failure or RLS error causes unhandled rejection → 500 page.
No fallback when token is provided but expired or invalid. Renders StudioJoinPage with studio=null but the token still shows in the URL — confusing UX.
new Date().toISOString() uses server time. If server is UTC and client is UTC+3, tokens created near midnight could appear expired prematurely.
No loading.tsx error boundary or Suspense fallback for this page.

per_file.verdict: Functional multi-strategy inviter lookup with metadata, but critically undermined by pervasive `as any` type casts across the entire component. Hardcoded Blossom colors (rgba(255,210,194,0.55)), bg-white/60, and text-white instead of theme tokens. These are not style preferences — they break the application on Studio/Frost themes.

issues.message: (result.data.profiles as any)?.full_name — as any cast bypasses all TypeScript safety. If Supabase schema changes, this fails silently at runtime.
const name = (profileRaw as any)?.full_name — same unchecked cast pattern.
((result!.data as any).avatar_emoji as string) — chained as any casts lose all type information. Non-null assertion result! also dangerous if result is null.
((result!.data as any).bio as string) || null — same pattern. After the null check at line 64, this shouldn't reach, but the as any is still unsafe.
rgba(255, 210, 194, 0.55) — hardcoded Blossom pink/peach. On Studio dark theme, this creates a pink spot against teal background. On Frost, it clashes with lavender.
bg-white/60 — hardcoded white background. On Studio theme, white has 60% opacity against dark teal — looks washed out. Should be bg-secondary/60.
text-white — should be text-primary-foreground. On Blossom theme, primary-foreground is #F5EDE0 (creamy), not pure white. On Studio, white is almost correct but should use the token for consistency.
h-13 is set via className then overridden with style={{ height: '3.25rem' }} — redundant duplicated value.

bio and city accessed with non-null assertion on result! — when !result (null block at line 107-115), these lines aren't reached because of the early return in the ternary. But the non-null assertion pattern is fragile.

per_file.verdict: Clean static generation with generateStaticParams, proper metadata, noindex on legal pages, and notFound for unknown slugs. dangerouslySetInnerHTML is justified for pre-rendered static content. Missing layout wrapper (no header/footer). Hardcoded border color #E8D0C8.

issues.message: prose-hr:border-[#E8D0C8] — hardcoded warm border color. Breaks on Studio (dark teal bg needs lighter borders) and Frost (indigo palette).
border-t border-[#E8D0C8] — same hardcoded border color for footer separator.
No layout.tsx in (public)/legal/ — page renders without site header, footer, or navigation. User can't easily return to main app.
dangerouslySetInnerHTML — Acceptable risk for pre-rendered static HTML, but if LEGAL_HTML ever accepts user input, this becomes an XSS vector.
generateStaticParams generates 4 pages at build time. If new legal docs are added, they won't appear until next build.

per_file.verdict: Small and simple offline fallback. Emoji used as visual indicator has no role=
or aria-label — screen readers interpret it as text character. text-white should be text-primary-foreground. window.location.reload() on offline page could create redirect loop.

issues.message: Emoji 📵 used as visual indicator without role='img' or aria-label. Screen readers read the Unicode description ('mobile phone with no signal') which is inconsistent across platforms. Should be 📵
onClick={() => window.location.reload()} — if the user is genuinely offline, this creates a reload loop. Should check navigator.onLine before reloading, or use a service worker message.
text-white — should be text-primary-foreground. On Blossom theme, accent-on is creamy #F5EDE0. Pure white stands out.
Page has no service worker registration or caching strategy — this is a basic offline page but browsers won't show it unless it's pre-cached by a service worker.

per_file.verdict: Clean route handler with proper error boundary (try/catch) and atomic operations (click increment + recipient update in parallel). Critical open redirect vulnerability: link.target_url is user-supplied and redirected to without validation. Non-null assertion on SITE_URL env var will crash if unset.

issues.message: OPEN REDIRECT: link.target_url is a database-supplied URL with NO validation or allowlist. An attacker who can create a broadcast_links row can redirect users to any URL (phishing, malware). Must validate against an allowlist of allowed domains or ensure it's a relative path.

new URL(link.target_url) — if target_url is a relative path (e.g., '/shop'), new URL() throws because there's no base URL. Only absolute URLs work. This silently crashes the route for relative target URLs.

process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL! — non-null assertion. In dev or preview deploys where this env var is not set, the redirect to '/' crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'origin')'.

Catch block silently swallows all errors. If the broadcast_links table doesn't exist (pre-migration), it's fine. But if there's a RLS or permission error, it silently falls through to the not-found redirect with no logging.
Missing link redirects to '/' with 302 instead of returning 404. Better UX would be 404 or a dedicated 'Link not found' page.

P0_blocking.message: THEMING CRISIS: 6 of 11 files contain hardcoded Blossom-specific colors (#6B5750, #A8928D, #FFE8DC, #2C1A14, rgba(255,210,194,0.55), #F5E8E3, #789A99, #E8D0C8, white overlays). These colors are invisible or visually broken on Studio (dark teal) and Frost (lavender slate) themes. Every hardcoded color must be replaced with a CSS variable or Tailwind theme token.

OPEN REDIRECT VULNERABILITY: link.target_url is redirected to without validation. Attacker-controlled database entry can redirect users to arbitrary external URLs (phishing risk). Must validate against an allowlist or ensure relative-path-only redirect.

TYPE SAFETY: Pervasive 'as any' casts (4+ instances) around Supabase join results. Any schema change silently propagates undefined values. Must fix the Supabase type generation or use proper type guards instead of type assertions.

P1_major.message: MONOLITH (1127 lines): Combines availability, flash deals, schedule, shop banner, portfolio gallery, services, products, reviews, trusted partners, loyalty, C2C, share, booking flow. Must decompose into page-level composition pattern.
isDark branching pattern: Uses manual if/else for every color instead of CSS variables. This duplicates every style decision per theme and is fragile when adding new themes.
CATEGORY_COLORS hardcoded hex palette not theme-aware.
Full-page background (#FFE8DC) and blob gradient (#FFD4BE) hardcoded Blossom-only. No fallback for other themes.
Emoji used as visual indicator without role='img' aria-label. Reload-on-click creates potential infinite reload loop.
Hardcoded bg-white/60 and text-white — must use bg-secondary/60 and text-primary-foreground.

P2_minor.message: Touch targets below 44px: ExplorePage filter/category chips (py-2.5), ShopPage filter chips (py-1.5). Bump to py-3 minimum.
Missing loading skeletons: ExplorePage no skeleton for masters list; ShopPage no skeleton for product grid.
Any-typed props: ShopPage workingHours?: any, schedule?: any[] — should be properly typed.
eslint-disable for dependency array: PublicMasterPage suppresses exhaustive-deps warning for C2C balance fetch.
Duplicated helpers: formatPrice and formatDuration defined in PublicMasterPage and StudioPublicPage separately. Extract to shared utils.

CSS variable usage via inline styles instead of Tailwind aliases: var(--surface) should be bg-secondary, var(--text-tertiary) should be text-muted-foreground, var(--accent-on) should be text-primary-foreground.
Legal pages missing layout wrapper — no header/footer navigation.
Safari incompatibility: StudioPublicPage uses grid-template-rows animation which Safari doesn't support.
Server timezone: studio/join and portfolio use new Date() for expiry/count queries. Server may be UTC while client is UTC+3.
Non-null assertions: PublicMasterPage schedule!, invite page result!. Fragile if data shapes change.
env var non-null assertion: r/[code]/route.ts uses NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL! without fallback.
42x duplicate text-white instead of text-primary-foreground: offline/page.tsx, invite/[code]/page.tsx.

P3_polish.message: getCategoryIcon recreated per render — extract to constant map.
non-null assertion master.schedule! — add optional chaining.
Portfolio card aspect-ratio hardcoded square (size-44) — use object-contain for non-square images.
generateStaticParams lock-in — new legal docs need build to appear.

summary.best_file: StudioPublicPage.tsx (33/40) — clean scope, good empty state, proper accordion pattern
summary.worst_file: invite/[code]/page.tsx (20/40) — pervasive as any casts, hardcoded colors breaking theming
key_actions: 1. THEMING: Audit all 6 files with hardcoded Blossom colors → replace with CSS variables/Tailwind tokens (P0)
2. SECURITY: Fix open redirect in r/[code]/route.ts with URL validation (P0)
3. TYPES: Fix all as any casts in invite/[code]/page.tsx with proper Supabase types or type guards (P0)
4. DECOMPOSE: Extract PublicMasterPage (1127 lines) into page-level composition (P1)
5. A11Y: Fix offline page emoji, add loading skeletons, bump touch targets to 44px (P1-P2)
6. I18N/TZ: Replace server new Date() in time-sensitive queries with client-aware timestamp (P2)
summary.html_emoji_note: globals.css shows UCS-2 encoded placeholder emoji blocks (rendered as �) — verify file encoding is UTF-8 without BOM in the CSS file.
